title: Merchant onboarding documents
text: To onboard a new merchant the sales team needs the business registration certificate, GST number, a cancelled cheque for settlement, and the signed merchant agreement. Onboarding is not complete until KYC review is approved.

title: Settlement timelines
text: Card payments are settled to the merchant bank account within two business days of the transaction. Settlement can be delayed when KYC documents are pending or the account is under risk review.

title: Handling a chargeback
text: When a cardmember disputes a charge, the merchant receives a chargeback notice and has 20 days to respond with proof such as invoice, delivery confirmation or signed receipt. Missing the window means the dispute is decided in the cardmember's favour.

title: High chargeback rate review
text: Merchants whose chargeback rate stays above 1 percent for two consecutive months are flagged for a risk review. The relationship manager must contact the merchant and agree a remediation plan.

title: Pricing exceptions
text: Discount rate exceptions below the standard rate card need approval from the regional sales head and are only considered for merchants with monthly card spend above 50 lakh rupees.

title: Customer data and privacy
text: Sales staff must never share full card numbers, cardmember names or contact details with merchants or in internal chat. Use masked card numbers showing only the last four digits.

title: Terminal and POS issues
text: If a merchant reports that card terminals are declining transactions, check the terminal ID status in the merchant portal, ask the merchant to restart the device, and raise a technical ticket if declines continue.

title: Merchant offboarding
text: A merchant can be offboarded on request or after a failed risk review. Pending settlements are paid out and open disputes must be closed before the account is terminated.

title: Promotional offers for merchants
text: Merchants can join cardmember offers such as cashback campaigns. Enrolment requires the merchant to fund the offer and agree the campaign dates with the marketing team.

title: Escalation to relationship manager
text: Complaints about settlement delays longer than five business days, repeated terminal failures or pricing disputes should be escalated to the merchant's relationship manager within one business day.
